summary:
Phase 7 (Construction Stage Master + Tower Construction Status + Payment Plan Master + Auto Dues engine) end-to-end tested. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase_7.py — 20/20 PASS (health v7.x, /api/master/milestone-templates returns 410 LEGACY_GONE, legacy /blocks/{id}/milestones alias 200, BK-2526-0001 due=0 + payment_plan_snapshot='Standard CLP' + 22 ledger rows + every non-void demand has installment_seq; Payment Plan master validations — sum!=100, duplicate seq, two ON_BOOKING, ON_STAGE without stage all 400/422; valid plan create+deactivate roundtrip ok; GET /api/projects/{SGH}/blocks/{TowerA}/payment-plans returns Standard CLP + Down Payment 10:85:5 + Flexi 10:40:50; GGV Villa Block V returns Villa CLP; POST /api/payment-plan-assignments with Standard CLP → Villa Block V correctly rejected with 409; Tower B construction endpoint returns 11 stages / 2 Completed (Foundation+Plinth) / construction_percent=18; /api/customers?has_overdue=true 200; Customer 360 bookings carry plan info; /api/reports/upcoming-dues and /api/reports/demand-vs-collection 200; Portal (phone 9431012345) GET /api/portal/bookings/{id} includes payment_plan {name, plan_type}; /schedule rows have trigger_label/due_date/status/percent; /construction returns both stages & milestones arrays). test_portal_leaks.py — 2/2 PASS.

Frontend (desktop 1366×900, admin@kkt.in / Kkt@12345): ERP login + /erp/dashboard load OK. Master Data → Payment Plans tab visible, 'New Payment Plan' sheet opens with ALL expected testids (pp-name, pp-code, pp-type, pp-add-row, pp-sum, pp-save, pp-row-0-name/pct/trigger). pp-sum shows 'Σ 10.00% ≠ 100' when installments total ≠ 100 and pp-save is disabled. /erp/projects/{SGH} shows project-tabs with 'project-tab-payment-plans'; clicking it renders payment-plan-matrix with ppm-{CODE}-{blockId|all} checkboxes and default radio for Standard CLP (shown as default across Towers A & B & C). /erp/blocks/{TowerB} → block-milestones-btn opens construction-status-panel showing '18% · current: Plinth · next: 1st Slab', 11 stages timeline (Foundation + Plinth marked Completed), cs-stage-select, cs-mark-btn ('Update'), cs-undo-btn ('Undo last'). Booking wizard at /erp/bookings/new renders wizard-steps with exact labels: Project & Block, Unit, Customer, Agreement, Payment Plan, Charges & Parking, Review. Migration report GET /api/admin/migration-report returns {ok:true, bookings_checked:10, plans_created:[Standard CLP, Villa CLP], stages_created:16}.

NOT executed to preserve seed state (per owner constraint 'leave seed state intact — Tower B must end at 2/11'): (a) actual stage-mark + demand-raise + undo cycle on Tower B, (b) end-to-end booking creation on Tower A with Down Payment plan + subsequent cancellation. Backend endpoints for both exist and are reachable; UI testids are present. Suggest main agent run these with a dedicated test tenant.

minor.issue: Response collections object is MISSING keys 'dues_raised_month' and 'upcoming_installments' which Dashboard.jsx reads from `data.collections` to render StatCards with testids 'dues-raised-month' and 'upcoming-installments'. The data IS available on /api/dashboard/widgets (correct shape), but the main /api/dashboard endpoint does not forward it. Result: those two Phase-7 StatCards never render on the Dashboard page.

Spec: 'bookings have plan_summary {plan_name, next_installment, raised, paid, due, overdue_count}'. Backend returns FLAT keys on each booking (plan_name, next_installment, overdue_count) and does NOT include raised/paid/due or wrap them under plan_summary. Frontend Customer 360 may be using the flat keys; alignment needed either in API shape or spec text.
Spec names this endpoint; actual implementation is /api/reports/demand-vs-collection (singular, no -installment suffix). Current route works; just rename or add an alias so documented URL resolves.
No DELETE method on master endpoints — deactivation is only via POST /{id}/deactivate. Spec test prompt mentioned DELETE; align docs or add DELETE alias to deactivate.

ui_bugs.issue: StatCards 'Dues raised this month' and 'Upcoming installments (30d)' never render because /api/dashboard response.collections lacks dues_raised_month/upcoming_installments. Dashboard.jsx line 47-48 gates render on those keys. Backend fix needed (see backend minor).

action_items: BACKEND: /api/dashboard collections payload must include dues_raised_month (object with count/total/paid) and upcoming_installments (array of {booking_number, installment, total, ...}) so Dashboard.jsx renders the two Phase-7 StatCards.

BACKEND/DOCS: Decide whether /api/customers/{id} should expose nested plan_summary object (plan_name, next_installment, raised, paid, due, overdue_count) as the Phase-7 spec says, or update spec/credentials.md to document the current flat shape.
BACKEND/DOCS: Add /api/reports/demand-vs-collection-installment alias (or rename spec) and optionally support DELETE /api/master/payment-plans/{id} as alias for /deactivate — purely doc/alias polish.
CLEANUP: One leftover TEST_PP_974db5 payment plan existed as Active in master data from a prior partial test run; this iteration deactivated it. No other seed drift detected.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/dashboard.py — the Phase-7 widget data (dues_raised_month, upcoming_installments) was added to dashboard_widgets.py but NOT merged into the primary /api/dashboard endpoint that the main Dashboard page actually consumes. This is why the UI testids spec'd for Phase 7 are absent from the UI tree.

routers/customers.py:238-247 — assembles plan_name / next_installment / overdue_count flat on each booking in get_customer response, but spec expects a nested plan_summary object including raised/paid/due. Either refactor to nested shape with those three money aggregates or update the spec.

routers/master.py — payment-plans only exposes POST /{id}/deactivate and PATCH {is_active:false}; no DELETE verb. Error message from master test prompt (DELETE) is misleading; add verb-alias or correct docs.

routers/construction.py:96 — construction response field is 'construction_percent' (not 'percent' as spec sometimes mentions); frontend uses the correct key but external consumers reading spec may be confused.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all Phase-7 testids rendered where expected except two Dashboard StatCards (blocked on backend payload gap)

test_credentials: ERP Super Admin admin@kkt.in / Kkt@12345. Portal 9431012345 / Buyer@12345. All per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Side-effects: (1) 2 new payment plans TEST_PP_f2c0e7 and TEST_PP_6a152b created + deactivated in-test (soft-delete). (2) One leftover plan from a prior test run TEST_PP_974db5 (Active) was discovered and deactivated to restore clean state. (3) One TEST_UI_PP form was opened in UI but NOT saved (sheet closed via Esc). (4) No bookings created, NO Tower B stages mutated — seed state (Tower B 2/11, BK-2526-0001 due=0, 22 ledger rows) is intact and verified by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_phase_7.py tests/test_portal_leaks.py -v -o 'addopts='`. All should pass. The ONLY unverified Phase-7 UI testids are [data-testid="dues-raised-month"] and [data-testid="upcoming-installments"] on /erp/dashboard — these will render ONLY after backend adds those two keys into /api/dashboard→collections. AC3 (Tower B stage mark + demand raise + idempotency + undo) and AC4 (full booking creation with Down Payment plan + cancellation) were intentionally NOT executed to preserve the deterministic seed state the owner mandated; the backend APIs exist and are documented in /app/backend/routers/construction.py (set_current_stage line 109, undo line 155, booking plan POST line 283).
rca of the issue: Phase-7 dashboard StatCards gap: dashboard_widgets.py enriches /api/dashboard/widgets with 'dues_raised_month' and 'upcoming_installments' but the primary Dashboard.jsx page uses useFetch('/dashboard') (routers/dashboard.py), whose response.collections object does not aggregate the Phase-7 fields. Fix is a 1-line merge in routers/dashboard.py to include the two aggregates (reuse the logic from dashboard_widgets.py). plan_summary shape divergence: get_customer in routers/customers.py produces flat booking fields instead of nested {plan_summary:{...}} — align either backend (preferred: nest fields and add raised/paid/due totals) or spec documentation.
